tip.bedrockux.crafting_table: Craft a crafting table from four wooden planks to unlock most recipes.
tip.bedrockux.bed: Sleeping in a bed sets your spawn point and skips the night.
tip.bedrockux.torch: Torches stop hostile mobs from spawning nearby.
tip.bedrockux.water_bucket: A bucket of water breaks any fall, no matter the height.
tip.bedrockux.boat: Boats are the fastest way to cross open water.
tip.bedrockux.shield: Hold a shield to block arrows and melee hits.
tip.bedrockux.compass: A compass always points to your world spawn.
tip.bedrockux.sneak: Sneaking keeps you from falling off edges.
tip.bedrockux.food: Eating keeps your hunger up, and full hunger heals you over time.
tip.bedrockux.creeper: Creepers are afraid of cats and ocelots.
text.bedrockux.loading.title: Loading
text.bedrockux.message.saving: Your game is being saved. Do not turn off the device.
